name: Why is precise framing critical for drywall, tile, and trim carpentry?

mainEntity.name: Why is precise framing critical for drywall, tile, and trim carpentry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing creates the essential structural foundation that directly dictates how well finish materials look and hold up. If studs are bowed, out of plumb, or out of square, drywall seams will show uneven ridges and baseboards will have visible gaps. In bathrooms, flat and plumb framing is critical; uneven studs cause large-format tiles to crack or develop uneven lippage. Because HH Remodeling LLC handles both the rough framing and the finish tile, drywall, and trim carpentry, our crew frames every wall with the final finish surfaces in mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumb and square framing prevents uneven drywall seams, ensures tile lays flat without lippage, and allows baseboards and casing to fit tight against the wall.
